citations.text: B. González Landín, D. Rossit, M. Méndez, M. Frutos (2025). Dataset of the paper "Modeling and solving an integrated periodic vehicle routing and capacitated facility location problem in the context of solid waste collection". Zenodo.

B. González Landín, D. Rossit, M. Méndez, M. Frutos (2025). Modeling and solving an integrated periodic vehicle routing and capacitated facility location problem in the context of solid waste collection. Annals of Operations Research 350, 979-1015.

description: Instances of an integrated periodic vehicle routing and capacitated facility location problem for municipal solid waste collection in Bahía Blanca, Argentina: candidate container sites, each with the waste it generates a day, and the travel times between them. Each instance's `waste.txt` is read: a point's longitude and latitude (the file writes longitude first) fill `lon` and `lat` and its daily waste generation passes through as `rate`; point 0, with no waste, is the depot. Each instance's travel time matrix (`times.txt`, minutes) and container types (`containers.txt`) are not read, since tasks/v1 holds no arcs and no instance-level tables.
name: Periodic vehicle routing and capacitated facility location for waste collection (Bahía Blanca)
